The space
Welcome to your perfect home away from home—where comfort, style, and skyline views come together.

This spacious five-bedroom home is designed for unforgettable stays, whether you’re visiting with family, friends, or celebrating something special. Each bedroom is thoughtfully furnished with cozy bedding and plenty of space to unwind, while the open-concept living areas make it easy to gather, relax, and enjoy time together.

The fully equipped kitchen is ready for everything from morning coffee to group dinners, and the large dining area provides the perfect setting to connect and make memories.

The true highlight of the home is the rooftop lounge. Take in stunning city views while sipping your morning coffee, enjoying sunset cocktails, or winding down under the stars. With comfortable seating and a welcoming atmosphere, it’s the ultimate spot to relax and soak in the energy of the city.

Located in a prime area, you’ll be just minutes from top restaurants, shopping, and local attractions—giving you the best of both convenience and retreat.

Whether you’re here for a weekend getaway or an extended stay, this home offers the perfect blend of space, comfort, and unforgettable views.
